auth.nativeCredentialPath: PAPRIKA_API_KEY uses Authorization Key; PAPRIKA_USER/PASSWD obtains console Bearer; PAPRIKA_PROJECT_ID scopes workload. Protected XDG cache paprika/token outside repo.
auth.missingCredentialWorkflow: User opens paprika.art console Developer API keys/projects; explicit token creation authorization required. Existing scripts handle console login and refresh privately; open key only shown once.
auth.subjectAndResourcePermissionVerification: GET /v1/auth/me for console subject/roles and read project/key metadata; require project:manage/apikey:manage/generation:create/billing:manage only for intended operation. API Key subject mapping from console metadata.
auth.issuanceConsumptionRevocation: POST /v1/auth/login and /v1/auth/refresh existing contract; API key creation and POST /v1/console/api-keys/{keyId}/revoke are writes. Console token revocation not established.
auth.credentialHandling: Private injection only; never print/store secrets in repository, command arguments, chat or receipts. Discovery itself performs no login/token creation.
